name: Shell Om- Pref.sh SAOG
description: SOMP represents the listed preferred share class of Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG on the Muscat Stock Exchange Parallel Market, providing exposure to the same underlying downstream energy business as ordinary shares (SOMS). Consolidated into UK-based ultimate parent Shell plc, Shell Oman Marketing is a leading Omani downstream fuel and lubricants marketer engaged in retail mobility service stations, convenience retail, commercial petroleum distribution, and lubricants blending. Across its nationwide network, the company differentiates through premium Shell V-Power and V-Power Racing 98 fuels, non-fuel convenience offerings, and the Shell GO+ digital loyalty ecosystem.
highlights: Underlying issuer Shell Oman Marketing SAOG grew 9M 2026 revenue 11% YoY to OMR 407.40M on strong fuel and non-fuel mobility volumes, lifting net profit 27% YoY to OMR 5.816M.
Expanded its premium fuels footprint in Q3 2026 by commissioning two additional service stations offering Shell V-Power Racing 98 alongside targeted retail engagement campaigns.
